# Vendored front-end assets

Served by the portal itself, so the page needs no public CDN — a proxy that
blocks one cannot leave it unstyled. Nothing here is built in Docker: the files
are committed as they are.

| File(s) | What | Version / source | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tailwind.css` | The Tailwind classes the portal uses, pre-built | Tailwind CSS v3.4.17, generated by `scripts/css/build.sh` | MIT |
| `fontawesome/css/{fontawesome,solid,brands}.min.css`, `fontawesome/webfonts/fa-{solid-900,brands-400}.woff2` | Icons (only the solid and brands sets are used) | Font Awesome Free 6.5.1, from cdnjs | CSS: MIT · fonts: SIL OFL 1.1 |
| `inter/inter-latin-wght-normal.woff2` | The Inter typeface, latin subset, all weights (variable) | @fontsource-variable/inter 5.2.5 | SIL OFL 1.1 |
| `chart.umd.min.js` | Charts in chat answers | Chart.js | MIT |

## Rebuilding `tailwind.css`

Tailwind finds classes by scanning `static/**/*.js` and the page shell in
`app_fastapi.py` for complete class names. After using a class the page has not
used before, run:

```bash
TAILWIND_CLI=/path/to/tailwindcss-v3.4.17 scripts/css/build.sh
```

and commit the result. The CLI is a single binary (no Node or npm) from the
Tailwind v3.4.17 GitHub release. `tests/test_ui_vendor.py` fails if the
committed file is stale wherever the CLI is available.
